body:
Direct founder redesign of same-day S487: the spawner marker (where cubes spawn) is now also the camera's orbit pivot, continuously synced every frame from whatever moved it. W/A/S/D switched to horizontal-only movement (matching the original pre-S487 nudge math, since the spawner is a floorplan-building marker), Q/E vertical, Shift boost. 'Zoom all the way in and you see the spawner' falls out for free from target=spawner position. Middle-mouse orbit and left-click interactions untouched. tsc/vite clean, deployed, verified in dist/ and binary. IDUNA 7515bd4.

⚓ ☃
title: WASD moves the spawner, spawner is the camera orbit pivot (S489)
